def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}

from collections import Counter
import json
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    div=None
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg: div=('h',i); break
    if div is None:
        for j in range(w):
            cc={g[i][j] for i in range(h)}
            if len(cc)==1 and g[0][j]!=bg: div=('v',j); break
    o,c=div
    dcol=g[c][0] if o=='h' else g[0][c]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,dcol)]
    if o=='h':
        side=-1 if cells[0][0]<c else 1
        near=max(r for r,_ in cells) if side==-1 else min(r for r,_ in cells)
        shift=c+side-near
        new=[row[:] for row in g]
        for i,j in cells: new[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in cells: new[i+shift][j]=g[i][j]
        far=min(r for r,_ in cells)+shift-1 if side==-1 else max(r for r,_ in cells)+shift+1
        new[far]=[8]*w
    else:
        side=-1 if cells[0][1]<c else 1
        near=max(j for _,j in cells) if side==-1 else min(j for _,j in cells)
        shift=c+side-near
        new=[row[:] for row in g]
        for i,j in cells: new[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in cells: new[i][j+shift]=g[i][j]
        far=min(j for _,j in cells)+shift-1 if side==-1 else max(j for _,j in cells)+shift+1
        for i in range(h): new[i][far]=8
    return new

for k in sorted(G):

out=f(G['Test input'])

lib = '''def background(grid):
    """The most common cell color in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def find_divider(grid, bg=None):
    """(orientation, index) of the full row or column of one non-background color; (None, None) if none."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = background(grid) if bg is None else bg
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[i])) == 1 and grid[i][0] != bg:
            return ('h', i)
    for j in range(w):
        cc = {grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}
        if len(cc) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg:
            return ('v', j)
    return (None, None)

def object_cells(grid, bg=None, exclude=()):
    """All (i, j) cells whose color is not the background or any color in exclude."""
    bg = background(grid) if bg is None else bg
    return [(i, j) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0]))
            if grid[i][j] != bg and grid[i][j] not in exclude]

def snap_to_divider(grid, new=8):
    """Slide the object along the divider's perpendicular axis until it touches the divider, then draw a full-length line of color new on the object's far side."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = background(grid)
    o, c = find_divider(grid, bg)
    dcol = grid[c][0] if o == 'h' else grid[0][c]
    cells = object_cells(grid, bg, exclude=(dcol,))

        for i, j in cells: newg[i][j] = bg
        for i, j in cells: newg[i + shift][j] = grid[i][j]
        far = min(r for r, _ in cells) + shift - 1 if side == -1 else max(r for r, _ in cells) + shift + 1

import importlib.util
def load_mod(path):
    name=os.path.basename(path)[:-3].replace('-','_')
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
    m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[name]=m; spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m
